cake.prep: Grease your pan ({pan}) and line the bottom with parchment paper.
cake.cook: Pour the batter into the pan and smooth the top. Bake at {temp} for {time}, until golden and the cake springs back when lightly pressed.
cake.check: A toothpick inserted into the center should come out clean.
notes: Cool in the pan for 10 minutes before turning out.
Smaller or larger pans change the baking time - start checking early with a small pan.

recipes.name: Simple Vanilla Cake
recipes.description: A soft, buttery one-bowl-style vanilla cake that is easy to dress up.

yield.note: Based on one 8 in (20 cm) round cake.

less.note: Sugar keeps cake tender and moist, so the reduction is about 20% - going lower can make it dry and dense.
expectedChanges: Crumb may be slightly less tender and moist

steps.title: Cream Butter and Sugar
steps.text: Beat the softened butter and sugar until pale and fluffy, about 3 minutes.

steps.title: Add Eggs and Vanilla
steps.text: Beat in the eggs one at a time, then the vanilla.

steps.title: Mix Dry Ingredients
steps.text: In a separate bowl, whisk together the flour, baking powder and salt.

steps.title: Combine
steps.text: Add the dry ingredients to the butter mixture in two additions, alternating with the milk. Mix until just smooth.

steps.title: Cool
steps.text: Cool in the pan for 10 minutes, then turn out onto a wire rack and cool completely before frosting.

tips: Room-temperature ingredients mix into a smoother, higher-rising batter.
Do not open the oven door during the first 20 minutes.
Frost only when the cake is completely cool.

recipes.name: Chocolate Cake
recipes.description: A moist, deeply chocolatey oil-based cake.

yield.note: Based on one 8 in (20 cm) round cake.

less.note: Cocoa is bitter and sugar keeps the crumb moist, so the safe reduction is about 20%.
expectedChanges: Chocolate flavor tastes a little more intense
Crumb may be slightly less moist

steps.title: Mix Dry Ingredients
steps.text: In a large bowl, whisk together the flour, cocoa powder, sugar, baking powder, baking soda and salt.

steps.title: Mix Wet Ingredients
steps.text: In another bowl, whisk the eggs, milk, oil and vanilla until smooth.

steps.title: Combine
steps.text: Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and whisk until smooth - the batter will be fairly thin.

steps.title: Cool
steps.text: Cool in the pan for 10 minutes, then turn out onto a wire rack and cool completely before frosting.

tips: The batter is thin - that is what makes the cake moist.
Sift the cocoa to avoid dry lumps.
Do not overbake - chocolate cake dries out quickly.
